summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run or committed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, buffering the control only when is_terminal is true; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200; tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests, mypy, and Black were not run, so all verification is by reading only.
